description: This file defines the 'CategoriesFragment' class, a UI component that displays categories as chips, and shows recipes filtered by selected category. It manages view inflation, category selection, and data loading via coroutines.

classes.name: CategoriesFragment
classes.description: A Fragment displaying recipe categories as chips and listing recipes for the selected category. Handles user interaction with category chips and loads recipes from the repository.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment from R.layout.fragment_categories.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes views, sets up the category chips, and loads initial recipes.

methods.name: loadCategory
methods.description: Loads recipes for a specified category and updates the UI state accordingly.
